content.title: UBS starts Roblox at Neutral, says unique platform but growth moderating in 2026
content.summary: Investing.com -- UBS initiated coverage of Roblox with a Neutral rating and a $103 price target, saying the company remains a unique asset in interactive entertainment but is likely to face slower growth next year as it laps several viral hits and increases investment to support a larger user base.

content.title: Russia blocks access to US children's gaming platform Roblox
content.summary: Dec 3 (Reuters) - Russia has blocked access to the U.S. children's gaming platform Roblox, accusing it of distributing extremist materials and "LGBT propaganda".
